information: Registration Fee:  $5+n, where n is the number of events you will compete in x $1.00. Tentative events, if held, will be free.  You will be given the option to pay by PayPal; however, if you choose to pay on the day of the competition (9/17/11) the registration fee will be raised to $10 as a base and $2 for each additional event.
